---
name: pr-readiness-review
description: Assess whether an assigned change is ready for project-owner PR review.
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/coordination/PROJECT_STATUS.md`, `CURRENT_TASKS.md`, `AGENT_HANDOFF.md`, and applicable contribution/security/testing docs. Inspect the complete diff, branch/base, changed files, tests and CI evidence, documentation, compatibility, dependency effects, and overlapping work. Report blockers, unresolved decisions, missing validation, and residual risks. Check that research artifacts and negative results are preserved and that security claims are accurate. Do not merge or push; readiness is a recommendation and the project owner retains approval authority.
